items.question: Which Veo 3 model is better for image-to-video tests?
items.answer: Both support image-to-video and optional audio. Start with Lite for lower-cost 720p or 1080p tests; choose Fast for 4K delivery or multiple reference images.

items.question: Is Veo 3.1 Lite or Veo 3.1 Fast better for text-to-video drafts?
items.answer: Start with Lite for lower-cost drafts in 720p or 1080p. Choose Fast when you need 4K output or a workflow using several reference images. Audio can be enabled or disabled on both.
